title: Traditional Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Saudi dish featuring marinated lamb skewers grilled to perfection, served with a side of tangy tahini sauce.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Jagged red onions, thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: Use a mandoline for precise slices

ingredients.name: Dense pita bread, torn into small pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the kebabs hot with a side of tahini sauce and pita bread.
To make tahini sauce, whisk together 250ml tahini paste, 120ml lemon juice, and 60ml water in a bowl.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the sauce chilled or at room temperature.
